Repo commit observed: a5fc80eab415 — Merge PR #287: project-memory: add Render evidence runtime invocation bridge

Merge Render evidence runtime invocation bridge into dev/v2-start.

- Add explicit Render Evidence Runtime Invocation Bridge
- Connect RenderEvidenceBridge sanitized evidence to ProjectMemory RuntimeTrustedEventTool
- Preserve boundary: Project Memory does not fetch Render
- Preserve boundary: RenderEvidenceBridge does not write Project Memory

- Add dedicated GitHub Actions smoke workflow

Approved by Monarch.
